statement.zh: 教科文将查文德万塔尔列入世界遗产，强调其安第斯形成期仪礼建筑与石雕（UNESCO 330）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Chavín de Huántar as World Heritage, emphasizing Formative Andean ceremonial architecture and lithic sculpture (UNESCO 330).

statement.zh: Burger 综合将查文表述为早地平线安第斯重要仪礼与互动中心（Burger 1992）。
statement.en: Burger's synthesis frames Chavín as a major Early Horizon Andean ceremonial and interaction centre (Burger 1992).

statement.zh: Burger 1984 专著建立查文德万塔尔史前占用与陶瓷序列的基础田野框架（UCP Anthropology 14）。
statement.en: Burger 1984 establishes a foundational field frame for prehistoric occupation and ceramic sequence at Chavín de Huántar (UCP Anthropology 14).

statement.zh: 斯坦福 Rick 长期项目以廊道、广场与建筑声学等取径持续发掘查文德万塔尔（项目门户/论著传统）。
statement.en: Stanford Rick long-term project continues excavation at Chavín de Huántar via galleries, plazas, and architectural-acoustics approaches (project portal / publication tradition).

statement.zh: Nesbitt & Burger 2023 文集在二十一世纪框架下重审查文现象与互动圈（Dumbarton Oaks / HUP）。
statement.en: Nesbitt & Burger 2023 reconsider the Chavín phenomenon and interaction sphere in a twenty-first-century frame (Dumbarton Oaks / HUP).

statement.zh: Kembel/Rick 研究传统讨论查文庙宇建筑分期与圆形广场等空间（建筑年代学取向）。
statement.en: Kembel/Rick research tradition discusses temple architectural phasing and spaces such as the circular plaza (architectural chronology orientation).

statement.zh: 文献常将孔图尔瓦西、帕科潘帕等形成期中心与查文圈比较讨论，但不自动等同为同一政体（Burger / Nesbitt–Burger）。
statement.en: Literature often compares Formative centres such as Kuntur Wasi and Pacopampa with the Chavín sphere without equating them as one polity (Burger / Nesbitt–Burger).

statement.zh: 教科文与综合著作将兰宗石像与廊道系统表述为查文仪礼建筑的标志性要素（UNESCO 330；Burger 1992）。
statement.en: UNESCO and syntheses frame the Lanzón and gallery system as hallmark elements of Chavín ceremonial architecture (UNESCO 330; Burger 1992).

statement.zh: 查文德万塔尔建筑石雕传统包括榫头头像等要素，见于教科文与综合描述（UNESCO 330；Burger 1992）。
statement.en: Chavín de Huántar architectural sculpture tradition includes tenon heads among other elements, as described by UNESCO and syntheses (UNESCO 330; Burger 1992).

statement.zh: Burger 陶瓷序列使用佳纳巴里乌等风格标签描述查文繁荣期陶业（Burger 1984/1992）；绝对年代仍可修订。
statement.en: Burger's ceramic sequence uses labels such as Janabarriu for Chavín floruit pottery (Burger 1984/1992); absolute dates remain revisable.
